probing_attack.notes: Very cautious contact. Deals little damage, takes far less harm, and breaks early.

layered_delaying.notes: Elastic defense. Gives ground slowly, takes much less harm, and buys time.

all_out_offense.notes: Hard assault. Much more firepower, high exposure, and a lower break point.

last_stand.notes: Refuses to yield. Holds longest by accepting extreme losses before breaking.

pinning_attack.notes: Fixes the enemy in place with moderate fire and lower exposure, but disengages early.
